how_to_use: Read DESIGN-CHECK.md first. Each section: source page and id, a Navigator deep link (view), frames with labels and widths, and PNG exports (light and dark). static_html is a plain inline-styled fragment where the section has no runtime holes (all v1.3 sections).

sections.title: G1Principles
sections.intro: Brick Work is a quiet workbench for one person and one collection. It sits inside Toni's World and shares its tokens: paper-and-ink surfaces, 0.5 px hairlines, no shadows, no gradients, no emoji. Clay is the only interaction colour.Direction·Reduced, usability first.·One primary action per screen.·Data types are told apart by form, not by colour (see 1a).·Hichert SUCCESS where it carries meaning: found, complete, difference.Voice·Warm, short, sentence case.·Bare counts, mid-dots, no exclamation marks.·Names: Part to Inventory, Check Set Parts, Tools & Admin, Wishlist, "Set 1" for a copy.·English UI.Never·The word LEGO, its logo or red and yellow.·A second interaction colour, gradients, shadows, emoji, a mascot.·A colour without its name, or a bare colour dot.·Brand accent (teal) on controls, data, charts or status.Devices·Main: 2020 MacBook, 1440 × 900 and 1280 × 800.·Sometimes: iPad mini 5, 768 × 1024 and 1024 × 768.·Very rarely: iPhone 16, 390.·Every workflow shows all sizes in one row on its page.

sections.title: G2Colour guidance · part colours
sections.intro: A part colour is a swatch filled with that colour, with its name inside. Everywhere, in the same form, in both themes.Source·Rebrickable colour catalogue (colors.csv): id, name, rgb, is_trans. Sample data: test-data/colors.json (43 colours).·Join on the Rebrickable colour id. BrickLink and LDraw names differ; always show the Rebrickable name.·Do not hard-code colours in screens. Draw from the catalogue; refresh it with the catalogue sync.Fill and ink·Fill = the colour's rgb.·Ink = #1A1816 when relative luminance is above 0.45, otherwise paper #FAFAF8. Same rule in light and dark.·Transparent colours: fill at 55 % over the page ground, name in dark ink, never a checkerboard.·Unknown id: name "Unknown colour", neutral --tw-surface-2 fill, raw id in mono. Never guess a colour.Order and use·Colour first, part number second: "Dark Brown · 3022".·Colour is identity, not status. Status uses the status pills only.·Required colour on a part screen is a tile at least 96 px tall; lists use the 22 px inline chip; choosing uses 56 px chips.Three sizesInline 22 pxBlackTanWhiteChoice 56 pxBlackTanDark Bluish GrayDark BrownLight Bluish GrayRebrickable sample · 43 coloursBlackBlueGreenDark TurquoiseRedBrownLight GrayDark GrayBright GreenYellowWhiteTanOrangeLimeDark TanMedium LavenderTrans-Dark BlueTrans-GreenTrans-RedTrans-Light BlueTrans-YellowTrans-ClearReddish BrownLight Bluish GrayDark Bluish GrayMedium BlueLight NougatMedium NougatYellowish GreenFlat SilverTrans-OrangeBright Light OrangeDark BluePearl GoldDark BrownDark RedDark AzureMedium AzureOlive GreenSand GreenDark OrangePearl Titanium[No Color/Any Color]

sections.title: API tokens
sections.intro: Stored, scoped tokens for the app's own API. Scopes as chips. A new token is shown once, with Copy. Revoke asks first, then offers Undo. A token from the install environment is marked and has no Revoke.

sections.title: Collection sync
sections.intro: Bring an existing collection in from Rebrickable, Brickset or BrickLink using the configured keys (12l), work on it here, then send the changes back. Pull shows every difference first and never deletes here; Send shows the changes first and asks before removing anything there. A source card shows the link, scopes, last pull and send, and what is waiting. Rows: sources at four widths; link a collection; pull preview; send review; changed in both places; sending, sent, paused, key rejected; no keys.

frames.label: iPad landscape · 1024 · changed in both places

sections.title: Scan a set barcode
sections.intro: Add (4d) gets a barcode scanner. Phone: the camera reads the EAN on the box, a sheet shows the matching set with a condition selector (Sealed, New, Used), copies, storage and price paid, then adds it; Keep scanning returns to the camera with an Undo toast. Desktop and iPad: camera or USB scanner into one field, a session list with condition per set, and one add for all. Barcodes are looked up on Brickset with the configured key.
